name: separation_one_stroke
description: Draw one continuous stroke from the bottom-left to the top-right so same-colored cells stay together and different colors are separated.

difficulty_params.difficulty: Generated by random legal path, random region-safe color blocks, then BFS shortest-solution filtering: 4x4 easy, 5x5 medium, 6x6 hard.
difficulty_params.board_size: Procedural cell-grid size: 4x4 easy, 5x5 medium, 6x6 hard; internally this maps to vertex grids 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7.
difficulty_params.seed: Requested procedural seed. Direct generation starts at 1 and increments by 1 for each generated setup.
difficulty_params.setup_seed: Internal mixed procedural generation seed for the requested board-size and seed.
difficulty_params.grid_size: Generated mode uses vertex grid size W x H from 5x5 through 7x7.
difficulty_params.num_colors: Number of distinct colors used in the puzzle: easy 3, medium 3-5, hard 5-7.
difficulty_params.color_block_counts: How many cells are assigned to each color.

action_space: Discrete(4) mapped to U/D/L/R direction moves.
observation_space: RGB screenshot exported from the Three.js renderer.
